questions.stem: Why has paediatric epidural analgesia become more popular?
questions.answer: More focus on good analgesia in children

questions.stem: Beyond good analgesia, what does a paediatric epidural allow?
questions.answer: Light anaesthesia, minimal opioid, early extubation and no postoperative ventilation

questions.stem: In which high-risk paediatric cases do epidurals give better outcomes?
questions.answer: Open fundoplication, severe respiratory disease with abdominal surgery, neonatal oesophageal atresia repair

questions.stem: How are paediatric epidural catheter openings usually arranged?
options: Several side holes and no end hole
One end hole and no side holes
Two end holes and side holes
Side holes only, with a blind tip

questions.stem: Which surgery types suit a paediatric epidural for intra- and postoperative analgesia?
options: Thoracic, abdominal or lower body surgery

questions.stem: When is a paediatric epidural most useful for analgesia?
questions.answer: After major surgery with prolonged severe pain

questions.stem: How strong is the evidence that paediatric epidurals beat IV opioids for analgesia?
options: Strong evidence, clearly superior to IV opioids
Limited evidence; not clearly better than IV opioids
No evidence of any benefit over IV opioids
Good evidence, but only in neonates

questions.stem: Paediatric epidural contraindications match those of which blocks?
Is a ventriculoperitoneal shunt a contraindication to a paediatric epidural?
questions.answer: No; use strict asepsis and consider prophylactic antibiotics

questions.stem: What is the rough lumbar epidural depth rule for a child over 1 year?
Which lumbar interspaces suit a paediatric epidural, given that young children's cords end lower?
How does paediatric epidural technique differ from the adult technique?
questions.answer: Much the same, except the child is anaesthetised

questions.stem: Which loss-of-resistance medium is preferred when placing a paediatric epidural?
Which approaches are used for paediatric epidural placement?
Do cervical epidurals have a place in paediatric practice?
options: No, they have no place in children

questions.stem: What Tuohy needle angle is best for a lumbar paediatric epidural?
In a paramedian paediatric epidural, how is the ligamentum flavum reached?
questions.answer: Contact the lamina, then walk off its upper edge

questions.stem: Which methods check the position of a paediatric epidural catheter tip?
questions.answer: X-ray, ultrasound (young children), or Tsui methods (ECG morphology or electrical stimulation)

questions.stem: At which level is the sacral intervertebral block easiest in children?
options: L4/5, level with the iliac crest
S2/3, just below the posterior superior iliac spine line
C7/T1, level with the shoulder line

questions.stem: What is the usual initial lumbar epidural bolus in children?
Which bupivacaine concentrations are usually used for a paediatric epidural infusion?
What is the maximum epidural bupivacaine infusion for children older than 6 months?
Maximum epidural bupivacaine infusion in infants under 6 months: ____ mg/kg/hour.
What is the standard paediatric epidural ropivacaine infusion?
Which epidural adjunct type has a good safety record in children?
What is the typical morphine epidural infusion rate in children?
What is the typical fentanyl epidural infusion rate in children?
What is the typical diamorphine epidural infusion rate in children?
Which effect of epidural opioids in children needs monitoring?
Where are children with a paediatric epidural often nursed?
Why do small children have fewer cardiovascular effects from epidurals?
questions.answer: Immature sympathetic system and low vascular tone

questions.stem: Hypotension without bleeding during a paediatric epidural most suggests what?
Above what age is hypotension more common with a paediatric epidural?
Which factors make a bloody tap more likely during paediatric epidural insertion?
questions.answer: IVC obstruction or excessive spinal flexion during insertion
